description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git restore' command with '--pathspec-from-file' options. It sets up a git repository, creates files, commits, tags, and runs various tests to verify the behavior of 'git restore' with different pathspec input formats and options.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git repository to a previously created checkpoint via 'git reset --hard checkpoint'.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Verifies the current state of specific files against expected state, utilizing 'git status --porcelain' and comparing output.
